component.name: CLIPFORGE
component.description: Merged SBOM: root React/Vite frontend package + server/ Express backend package (from both package-lock.json files) plus clearly-labelled non-npm runtime components (Python/system/models).

properties.name: clipforge:sbom-scope
properties.value: root package-lock.json (115 entries) + server package-lock.json (330 entries), deduplicated by purl, plus 11 non-npm components

components.name: av
components.description: PyAV, faster-whisper dependency (project scripts bypass its decode path per transcribe.py notes, but it is part of the installed runtime). Not pinned by any project manifest.

components.name: ctranslate2
components.description: Inference engine under faster-whisper. Not pinned by any project manifest.

components.name: espeak-ng
components.description: System package espeak-ng 1.51+dfsg-12build1; used by e2e test fixtures to synthesize speech (not a production runtime path).

components.name: face_detection_yunet_2023mar.onnx
components.description: YuNet face-detection ONNX model shipped in server/models/ (228K).

components.name: faster-whisper
components.description: Python STT engine used by server/scripts/transcribe.py (plus Silero VAD assets used by track.py). Installed in the machine Python environment; NOT pinned by any project manifest.

components.name: ffmpeg
components.description: System binary (Ubuntu package ffmpeg 7:8.1.2-2ubuntu2+hatch2) spawned by the server for media probing, transcoding, thumbnails, renders and exports; ffprobe is part of the same package.

components.name: numpy
components.description: Imported directly by server/scripts/transcribe.py and track.py. Not pinned by any project manifest.

components.name: onnxruntime
components.description: Runs YOLOv8n person detection and Silero VAD ONNX models in server/scripts/track.py. Not pinned by any project manifest.

components.name: opencv-python
components.description: Provides cv2 (FaceDetectorYN YuNet face detection) for server/scripts/track.py. opencv-python-headless 5.0.0.93 is also installed on this machine. Not pinned by any project manifest.

components.name: Python
components.description: System Python interpreter running server/scripts/*.py workers.

components.name: yolov8n.onnx
components.description: YOLOv8-nano person-detection ONNX model shipped in server/models/ (13M).
